alignment: Pair states and transitions by relative training opportunity h, never by Adam internal step.

distance.alignment: absolute difference of the global and registry-component cosine-alignment vector; undefined zero-norm coordinates are represented by an ExplicitDisposition and excluded only from that typed coordinate
distance.typed_non_numeric: exact identity/set comparison; nonnumeric identities are never subtracted

leave_out_policy: For every decline/stable pair, threshold construction excludes every stable window from either source entry represented by that pair.

stability_envelope.reference_population: all unique preregistered stable windows remaining after leave-out
stability_envelope.quantity: distance between each stable window state at h and its own h=0 state, separately for each channel and h
stability_envelope.crossing: pair_excess strictly exceeds max(the leave-out stability-envelope quantile,1e-12) for three consecutive legal relative steps

key_step.selection: earliest persistent crossing among admitted predictor channels
key_step.no_crossing_fallback: earliest h maximizing the channel-wise ratio pair_excess/max(envelope,1e-12), explicitly labeled NO_THRESHOLD_CROSSING_FALLBACK and never reported as a detected divergence

future_use: The audit is retrospective development evidence. Its detected step or fallback is not a prospective model input and cannot seal a candidate theory.
